scope: Initial consumer families, not exhaustive POSIX interface/options inventory or certification
status_meaning: native_status describes this project target; evidence may be Linux/host only as limits explicitly state

interfaces.limits: Bounded x86-64 static musl fixture; fixed developer identity/entropy, no general loader.
interfaces.required_witness: Exact target profile, malformed images and independent context values.

interfaces.limits: Opt-in native-memory v1: 128-page shared quota, anonymous private mappings, no brk/remap, single core/thread; general allocator/address-space scope unproven.
interfaces.required_witness: Native allocation, zeroing, quota failure, preservation on failed growth and cleanup.

interfaces.limits: Separate native file profile: pinned musl hook, four FDs/two open records, at most 16 bytes per call and EOF. Single-thread valid-local-buffer scope; older fixed-stream profile remains separate. Separate inherited-reference profile: actual musl read accepts exactly two bytes or local zero-length, broker-owned shared position, explicit EAGAIN, other positive sizes ENOTSUP; poisoned connection prevents replay. No general inherited EOF/stdio claim. New file-io mode: musl reads cap one request at 16 bytes, validate zero reads through owner, and exercise short results/repeated EOF with broker-owned position; no prefetch or general filesystem.
interfaces.required_witness: Blocking and interrupted reads, pipes/files, no consumption on invalid range.

interfaces.limits: Separate native file profile: pinned musl hook, at most 16 bytes per call into 64-byte volatile scratch supplied by the fixture; read-only denial. No public create/mode, signals or persistence. New inherited file-io mode: writable parent musl calls cap one request at 16 bytes, accept zero writes, enforce ENOSPC at 64 bytes and retain child zero-write denial; independent owner storage readback tested.
interfaces.required_witness: Exact partial/interrupted bytes, writable sinks and EPIPE/SIGPIPE.

interfaces.limits: Separate four-FD file profile: pinned musl close and final-reference consuming service close; private failure suite covers uncertain acknowledgement. No EINTR, concurrency or exec cleanup support. Separate inherited-reference profile: actual musl close consumes local binding once, preserves normal collection identity; uncertain reply poisons connection and repeated close gives EBADF, with remote outcome unresolved. New file-io mode retains consuming close and whole-connection poison; dropped-close reply tested after completed storage work, without remote recovery.
interfaces.required_witness: File/pipe lifetimes, errors, exec cleanup and no cross-instance leak.

interfaces.limits: Separate four-FD file profile: musl dup shares open-file position, lowest-free allocation and EMFILE tested. No descriptor flags, concurrency or inheritance.
interfaces.required_witness: Shared open-file offset, failed replacement preserves destination; descriptor flags.

interfaces.limits: Separate four-FD file profile: musl dup2 validates/replaces and shares position. Private close-error adaptation removes destination and poisons connection; not full POSIX failure semantics or inheritance.
interfaces.required_witness: Shared open-file offset, failed replacement preserves destination; descriptor flags.

interfaces.limits: Adapted public open supports read-only single-component service names; other flags return ENOTSUP. Native openat returns ENOSYS. No public create, permissions, directories, symlinks or global namespace.
interfaces.required_witness: Create/truncate/append, path denial, symlink policy and failed open cleanup.

interfaces.limits: No selectable nonblocking mode, FD_CLOEXEC or FD_CLOFORK.
interfaces.required_witness: Differentiate per-descriptor flags from shared status flags; test across fork/exec.

interfaces.limits: Explicit Issue 8 interface; fixed dup2 support does not include it.
interfaces.required_witness: Flag validation, equal-fd rejection, atomic flag installation.

interfaces.limits: Adapted public lseek supports SET/CUR positions 0-64, shared aliases, independent opens and overflow rejection. END and other modes return ENOTSUP; internal __lseek and append unadapted. Separate inherited profile demonstrates broker-owned shared positions through two-byte musl reads; it does not adopt inherited lseek. New file-io mode tests shared position across ordinary bounded musl reads/writes and EOF; inherited lseek remains unadopted.
interfaces.required_witness: Alias/child offsets, invalid seek and append behavior.

interfaces.limits: Fixture input queue is not user-created pipe pairs.
interfaces.required_witness: Early reader exit, duplicate end lifetime, EOF only after all writers close, atomic flags.

interfaces.limits: Fixed supervised instances are not process-image duplication.
interfaces.required_witness: Parent/child return values, memory independence, inherited open descriptions and CLOFORK exclusion.

interfaces.limits: Boot fixture launch does not replace a calling process image.
interfaces.required_witness: PATH/argv/env, failed exec keeps process intact, descriptor inheritance/CLOEXEC and signal state.

interfaces.limits: Potential future implementation choice, not an assumed replacement for arbitrary shell fork.
interfaces.required_witness: File actions, inheritance, cwd/groups/signals and launch failures.

interfaces.limits: Supervisor terminal retention is not parent wait/reap semantics.
interfaces.required_witness: Exact child status, no double reap, errors and interrupted wait.

interfaces.limits: Bounded single-thread terminal observation and cleanup; general process/files/stdio effects unproven.
interfaces.required_witness: Parent observation, descriptor closure, stdio flushing distinction and reclaim.

interfaces.limits: Reference signal tests do not establish native delivery.
interfaces.required_witness: Masks, default/ignored/caught actions, interruption/restart, authority and signal return.

interfaces.limits: No native namespace/cwd model.
interfaces.required_witness: Relative lookup, inaccessible cwd, child inheritance and cd/PWD behavior.

interfaces.limits: Package file modes do not provide runtime stat or permissions.
interfaces.required_witness: Types/modes/size, path/fd lookup, missing and denied cases.

interfaces.limits: No native directory stream or namespace mutation.
interfaces.required_witness: Enumeration, rename/unlink/mkdir errors, links and ownership-scoped lookup.

interfaces.limits: Bounded single-thread FILE subset: fread/fwrite/fgetc/fseek/fflush/fclose with dynamic native allocation, private vector callbacks, r/r+ fdopen and read-only fopen. Checked input-flush failure preserves unread bytes; errno survives failed implicit flush plus close. Formatted I/O, all modes, exit flushing and TTY remain untested.
interfaces.required_witness: Flush/close errors, short/interrupted sink, pipes and redirect stdout/stderr.

interfaces.limits: dash candidate not yet ported; Zsh is interactive destination, not a /bin/sh compatibility proof.
interfaces.required_witness: Quoting, variables, field splitting/globbing, substitution, lists/functions and status.

interfaces.limits: No native job control.
interfaces.required_witness: Separate jobs, controlling terminal authority, fg/bg, stop/continue and disconnect.

interfaces.limits: No native serial console or terminal discipline.
interfaces.required_witness: Canonical/raw/echo modes, Ctrl-C/Z, restoration and non-TTY errors.

interfaces.limits: Library availability does not establish target locale or display behavior.
interfaces.required_witness: C locale baseline; explicit UTF-8 policy, invalid bytes, combining/wide characters and fallback.

interfaces.limits: Fixed developer identity is not authenticated login or administrative authority.
interfaces.required_witness: Bind principal/session/grants, deny unauthorized transitions and clean up session.

interfaces.limits: Candidate commands only; no accepted versioned target package closure.
interfaces.required_witness: Per-command executable tests plus versions, digests, licenses and dependency closure.
